Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1957 (Insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor). Join activities to assays and target_dictionary using tid, and join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures using molregno. Filter to standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pChEMBL value not null. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
